summary: This note is a short biographical entry on Tiffany Stiegler, an American figure skater who competed in both pair skating and ice dancing. It notes her birth date and her pairs partnership with her brother Johnnie Stiegler, along with two competitive results: bronze at the 1998 Sparkassen Cup on Ice and fourth place at the 1999 World Junior Championships.
one_line: American figure skater who competed in pairs with her brother Johnnie and in ice dancing.
key_facts: Tiffany Stiegler was born on January 14, 1984.
Tiffany Stiegler is an American figure skater.
Tiffany Stiegler competed in both pair skating and ice dancing.
Tiffany Stiegler competed in pairs with her brother Johnnie Stiegler.
Tiffany Stiegler won the bronze medal at the 1998 Sparkassen Cup on Ice.
Tiffany Stiegler placed fourth at the 1999 World Junior Championships.
